title: "Mel's Tiki Bar"
content: I seem to have a common food place in my mallworld with the above name. Almost always really busy. You can smell the food so much (I'm literally slightly salivating remembering it) but the dream usually ends before I get to try the food unfortunately. Contrary the name, the place doesn't just sell touristy Hawaii themed food. It seems to sell whatever food your in the mood for. The place seems to be run by employees that feel like potentially other dreamers, not just "background people". The other night I "ordered" a whole pizza, three boxes of buttered shrimp and orange chicken, a whole chocolate cake, and 2 plates of strawberry sherbet 😅. The staff were super chill about this even though people were practically jumping over each other for food. I finally "found a seat" in the dream but kept getting stared down by large families of other people still waiting to be served which is odd because it felt more like an irl contemporary fast food/pick up type place, not a retro restaurant. For real though, why do I seem to wake up before I get the awesome food lol. As others have mentioned, dream food usually tastes absolutely incredible. The closest I can remember I actually managed to try was some sort of smoothie but it felt almost like I got woken up like I wasn't "allowed" to eat the dream foods.
